# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## shadcn/ui Primitives

**Do not edit files in this directory manually.** They are auto-generated by the shadcn CLI and will be overwritten on the next `npx shadcn add` or upgrade.

## Adding Components

```bash
npx shadcn add <component-name>
```

This writes the component source into this directory. After adding, the component is fully owned code — it won't be auto-updated by shadcn unless you re-run the command (which overwrites).

## How These Components Work

Each file wraps a **Radix UI primitive** with:
1. **CVA** (`class-variance-authority`) for variant management — e.g., `Button` has `variant` (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) and `size` (default, sm, lg, icon) variants.
2. **`cn()`** from `@/utils/cn` to merge class strings (clsx + tailwind-merge).
3. **CSS variable consumption** — colors/spacing come from the `@theme {}` block in `src/index.css`, not hardcoded values.

## Styling

These components use Tailwind utility classes that resolve to the CSS variables defined in `src/index.css`:
- `bg-primary` → `var(--color-primary)` → `var(--primary)`
- `text-muted-foreground` → `var(--color-muted-foreground)`
- `border-border` → `var(--color-border)`

To change the visual appearance of a shadcn component globally, update the CSS variable in `src/index.css`, not the component file.
